title: Pure Visas
summary: Pure Visas dimensional lore build, uniting Visas Starfrost, his awakened form Visas Samsara, and his synchro and fusion manifestations alongside his loyal Heart allies. The deck weaves together self-destruction combos and Planet searches to summon Visas Amritara, Vicious Astraloud, and towering Level 10 bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Visas Samsara counts as Visas Starfrost on field and in GY, Special Summons itself by shuffling 2 Visas monsters from GY, field, or banishment into the Deck, and can act as a non-Tuner for Synchro Summons.
Visas Starfrost destroys a monster you control with a different Type and Attribute to Special Summon itself from hand, triggering floating destructions.
Mannadium Riumheart destroys a Mannadium monster or a 1500 ATK/2100 DEF monster on field as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself, and searches a Mannadium card upon summon.
Scareclaw Reichheart Special Summons itself adjacent to Visas Starfrost or Scareclaw Light-Heart, searching Scareclaw Arrival on summon.
Peaceful Planet Calarium and Primitive Planet Reichphobia search Mannadium/Scareclaw monsters or Visas Starfrost, while Terraforming and Reinforcement of the Army provide instant access.
Scareclaw Light-Heart is a Link-1 monster summoned using Visas Starfrost or Reichheart that searches Primitive Planet Reichphobia on summon.

summary.title: Opening: Visas Samsara 1-Card Combo
steps: Normal Summon Visas Samsara (treated as Visas Starfrost on field).
Use Visas Samsara to Link Summon Scareclaw Light-Heart in the Extra Monster Zone.
Scareclaw Light-Heart triggers on summon to add Primitive Planet Reichphobia from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Reichphobia to search Scareclaw Reichheart from your Deck.
Special Summon Scareclaw Reichheart to a zone adjacent to Light-Heart, searching Scareclaw Arrival on summon.
Activate Scareclaw Arrival to revive Visas Samsara from your GY.
Synchro Summon Level 8 Visas Amritara using Level 4 Tuner Samsara and Level 4 non-Tuner Reichheart.
Amritara triggers to search Mannadium Reframing (or Calarium), while banishing Starfrost and Reichheart from GY Contact Fuses Vicious Astraloud.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Visas Amritara is treated as Visas Starfrost on field, searches any Spell or Trap that mentions Visas Starfrost on Synchro Summon, and destroys 1 card you control to grant all Synchros +800 ATK.

Vicious Astraloud is Contact Fused by banishing Visas Starfrost and a 1500 ATK/2100 DEF monster from field or GY, cannot be destroyed by battle, and targets and destroys an opponent monster on summon to gain half its ATK.
Mannadium Prime-Heart can attack multiple times per Battle Phase, cannot be targeted by card effects if summoned using a Mannadium Tuner, and floats into Visas Starfrost upon leaving the field.
Chaos Angel banishes a card on summon and makes your monsters immune to monster effects and battle destruction.
Bystial Dis Pater revives a banished LIGHT or DARK monster, and shuffles a banished card into the Deck to negate an activated monster effect or destroy a card.
S:P Little Knight banishes a card on the field or GY on summon and can banish two face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mannadium Reframing is a Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect while you control a Synchro Monster and a Visas or 1500/2100 monster, and recycles 3 Synchro Monsters from GY.
Trivikarma negates an opponent's Effect Monster while you control Visas Starfrost, and banishes itself from GY to search any Spell or Trap mentioning Visas Starfrost.
Realm Elegy destroys a monster you control while Visas Starfrost is on field to negate an opponent's monster effect and destroy it.
Scareclaw Arrival revives Visas Starfrost or a Scareclaw monster from GY in Defense Position, protecting Light-Heart from destruction from the GY.

allow.Scareclaw Reichheart: Level 4 DARK Warrior (1500 ATK / 2100 DEF) that Special Summons itself to a zone next to Visas Starfrost or Light-Heart, searches Scareclaw Arrival, and serves as the exact 1500/2100 material in the GY for Vicious Astraloud!
allow.Scareclaw Arrival: Normal Spell searched by Scareclaw Reichheart that revives Visas Starfrost or Reichheart from your GY and banishes itself from the GY to protect Vicious Astraloud or Light-Heart from destruction!
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Mannadium Riumheart or Scareclaw Reichheart.
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Peaceful Planet Calarium or Primitive Planet Reichphobia.
allow.Scareclaw Light-Heart: Link-1 DARK Beast-Warrior (1 Scareclaw monster or 'Visas Starfrost' in the Extra Monster Zone!) that searches Primitive Planet Reichphobia on Link Summon and revives itself from the GY while Visas Starfrost is on the field!
allow.Chaos Angel: Level 10 Synchro boss summoned using LIGHT Visas Starfrost/Amritara + DARK Scareclaw Reichheart/Vicious Astraloud that banishes a card on Summon and grants both LIGHT and DARK protection.

main: Visas Starfrost

Core Level 6 LIGHT Warrior Tuner (2100 ATK): destroys 1 monster you control with a different Type and Attribute to Special Summon itself from your hand and gain half its original ATK; and gains 300 ATK whenever it destroys an opponent's monster by battle.
Visas Samsara

Core Level 4 WIND Fairy Tuner (1500 ATK / 2100 DEF): its name becomes 'Visas Starfrost' on the field and in the GY (allowing a 1-card Link Summon into Scareclaw Light-Heart!); shuffles 2 'Visas' monsters from your GY, field, and/or banishment into the Deck to Special Summon itself from your hand, and can be treated as a non-Tuner for a Synchro Summon!
Mannadium Riumheart

Core Level 4 LIGHT Warrior (1500 ATK / 2100 DEF): destroys a Mannadium or 1500 ATK/2100 DEF monster you control during the Main Phase (Quick Effect) to Special Summon itself from your hand, and adds any 'Mannadium' card from your Deck to your hand on Normal or Special Summon!
Scareclaw Reichheart

Level 4 DARK Warrior (1500 ATK / 2100 DEF): Special Summons itself from your hand to a zone adjacent to Visas Starfrost or Scareclaw Light-Heart, and searches Scareclaw Arrival on Normal or Special Summon (+ draws 1 card if 3+ Defense Position monsters are on the field!).
Mannadium Meek

Level 2 WATER Fairy Tuner: Special Summons itself from your hand while you control Visas Starfrost or a 1500 ATK/2100 DEF monster; when destroyed by battle or card effect, Special Summons another Mannadium Meek from your Deck and can increase its Level by 2 (to Level 4!).
Mannadium Fearless

Level 2 EARTH Fairy Tuner: Special Summons itself from your hand while you control Visas Starfrost, and floats into another Fearless from your Deck when destroyed while boosting Synchro Monsters by 500 ATK.
Peaceful Planet Calarium

Field Spell (mentions 'Visas Starfrost'—searchable by Visas Amritara and Trivikarma!): adds any 'Mannadium' monster or 'Visas Starfrost' from your Deck to your hand on activation, boosts LIGHT monsters, and revives a destroyed Tuner once per turn!
Primitive Planet Reichphobia

Field Spell (mentions 'Visas Starfrost'—searchable by Scareclaw Light-Heart, Visas Amritara, and Trivikarma!): adds any 'Scareclaw' monster or 'Visas Starfrost' from your Deck to your hand on activation, and destroys 1 card on the field if 3+ Defense Position monsters are on the field!
Mannadium Imaginings

Normal Spell (mentions 'Visas Starfrost'—searchable by Riumheart and Amritara!): reveals a Mannadium or Visas Starfrost in your hand to draw 2 cards and bottom-deck 1 card from your hand, and banishes from GY to treat a 1500 ATK/2100 DEF monster as a Tuner!
Scareclaw Arrival
Searched by Scareclaw Reichheart: revives Visas Starfrost, Visas Samsara, or Reichheart from your GY in Defense Position.
Realm Elegy

Normal Spell (mentions 'Visas Starfrost'—searchable by Amritara!): adds a 'Veda' monster or destroys a monster you control while Visas Starfrost is on the field to negate an opponent's monster and destroy it if it has lower ATK.
Mannadium Reframing

Signature Counter Trap (mentions 'Visas Starfrost'—searchable by Visas Amritara, Riumheart, and Trivikarma!): when a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect is activated while you control a Synchro Monster, negates the activation and destroys it if you have 'Visas Starfrost' or a 1500 ATK/2100 DEF monster on your field or in your GY; banishes from GY to recycle 3 Synchro Monsters!
Trivikarma

Normal Trap: targets 'Visas Starfrost' you control and 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls to negate that opponent's monster and gain half its ATK/DEF; banishes itself from your GY to add ANY Spell/Trap that mentions 'Visas Starfrost' from your Deck to your hand!
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Mannadium Riumheart or Scareclaw Reichheart.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Peaceful Planet Calarium or Primitive Planet Reichphobia.
extra: Signature Level 8 LIGHT Warrior Synchro Tuner (1+ Tuners + 1 LIGHT monster: Level 6 Visas Starfrost + Level 2 Meek, or Level 4 Visas Samsara + Level 4 Riumheart): its name becomes 'Visas Starfrost' while on the field; when Synchro Summoned, adds ANY Spell/Trap that mentions 'Visas Starfrost' (Calarium, Reichphobia, Mannadium Reframing, or Trivikarma!) from your Deck to your hand; and destroys 1 monster you control to boost Synchro Monsters by 800 ATK!

Signature Level 8 DARK Fairy Contact Fusion boss ('Visas Starfrost' + 1 monster with 1500 ATK/2100 DEF): Must be Special Summoned from your Extra Deck by banishing the above cards from your field and/or GY; cannot be destroyed by battle; and targets 1 other monster on the field on Special Summon to destroy it and gain half its higher original ATK/DEF!

Level 10 LIGHT Fairy Synchro boss (1+ Tuners + 1 LIGHT monster: Level 8 Visas Amritara + Level 2 Meek!): can attack a number of times each Battle Phase up to the number of Tuners used as material; cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects if Synchro Summoned using a Mannadium Tuner; and Special Summons Visas Starfrost or a 1500/2100 monster from your GY/banishment if it leaves the field!
Level 6 LIGHT Fairy Synchro Tuner (Level 4 Riumheart + Level 2 Meek) that revives Level 2 Meek from your GY on Synchro Summon to immediately climb into Level 8 Visas Amritara!

Link-1 DARK Beast-Warrior (summoned using Visas Starfrost, Visas Samsara, or Scareclaw Reichheart in the Extra Monster Zone): adds 'Primitive Planet Reichphobia' from your Deck to your hand on Link Summon, and revives itself from your GY once per Duel while you control 'Visas Starfrost'!
Level 10 Synchro boss (summoned using LIGHT Visas Amritara/Starfrost + DARK Vicious Astraloud/Reichheart) that banishes a card on Summon and makes your monsters unaffected by monster effects.
Level 10 Synchro: Special Summons a banished LIGHT/DARK monster, and shuffles a banished card to destroy or negate.
Link-2: banishes a card on the field/GY on summon and banishes 2 face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.
